stories.title: Xi welcomes Trump to China ahead of trilateral with Putin
stories.summary: Trump landed in Shenzhen Wednesday and was greeted personally at the airport by Xi Jinping, with the two set for a historic Thursday trilateral expected to cover the Iran and Ukraine wars, trade, AI and nuclear weapons. Xi pledged to stand up against trade protectionism in pointed pre-summit speeches alongside Putin.

stories.title: White House Board of Peace faults Israel and Hamas for failure to end Gaza war
stories.summary: The body overseeing the US-backed ceasefire plan accused both sides of failing to meet their commitments in a 12-page report to the UN Security Council. It warns a ceasefire that delivers nothing visible cannot be sustained indefinitely, with the population of Gaza facing another winter in tents and rubble.

stories.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea amass forces along border, heightening war fears
stories.summary: Conflict monitors and militia-linked sources say the build-up has brought the two armies within striking distance of each other, fuelling fears of outright war between the historic rivals. ACLED and the International Crisis Group are among those tracking the escalation.

stories.title: EU proposes 45-billion-euro loan to Ukraine backed by joint debt
stories.summary: The European Commission unveiled the package - 25 billion euros for weapons and 20 billion for budget support - to cover two-thirds of the 70-billion-euro financing gap for 2027, with repayment contingent on Russia paying reparations. Von der Leyen said she is confident all 27 member states will back it.

stories.title: GTA 6 reviews land: 99 Metascore with 118 perfect scores
stories.summary: A day before its Nov 19 worldwide launch, the GTA 6 review embargo lifted with a record-tying 99 Metascore - level with Ocarina of Time for the highest ever - from 147 PS5 critic reviews, 118 of them perfect scores and zero mixed or negative.

stories.title: Waymo suspends freeway driving after California construction-zone ban
stories.summary: The California DMV ordered the driverless cars off state freeways over construction-zone incursions it called an imminent hazard, and the Alphabet unit has now pulled freeway rides across all of its markets. Its robotaxis continue operating on surface streets.

stories.title: Wall Street digests Nvidia beat as Anthropic IPO pricing nears
stories.summary: US stocks were mixed Wednesday as investors weighed a big Nvidia earnings beat - revenue up 103% to $115.8 billion - along with hawkish Fed minutes, with attention turning to the pricing of the Anthropic initial public offering as the next catalyst for the AI trade.

stories.title: Senators urge immediate White House action on AI-enabled cyber threats
stories.summary: Cantwell (D-WA) and Rounds (R-SD) warned AI czar Jay Clayton that AI is finding and exploiting software weaknesses faster than defenses can respond - citing PHP website flaws, rogue AI agents accessing bank accounts and breaches in Japan - and called for a coordinated national defensive-AI effort.

stories.title: Bernie Kosar celebrates one year after life-saving liver transplant
stories.summary: The Browns legend returned to University Hospitals with his doctors a year after his November 2025 liver transplant, sharing his recovery journey and celebrating how far he has come.

stories.title: Fraud watch on the 6-4 Browns? Power rankings lean the other way
stories.summary: The Browns are the first team in NFL history to win six games in a season all by four points or fewer, and national media keeps asking if they are legit as the bye week begins - even as Fox jumps them to 13th in its power rankings and beat writers note that beating the Raiders would make a playoff berth a virtual lock.

stories.title: NFL flexes Browns-Raiders into Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: The league moved the Nov 29 home game against Las Vegas into the primetime slot - the first Browns regular-season game on Sunday Night Football since 2021. History is not on their side: Cleveland is 2-11 all-time on Sunday nights.

stories.title: No. 14 Buckeyes look to keep playoff hopes alive at Nebraska
stories.summary: Ohio State (7-3) visits Lincoln on Saturday needing wins over Nebraska and Michigan - plus help - to stay in the Big Ten title and CFP races. Ryan Day says his team needs help but knows there is a chance, while Nebraska coach Matt Rhule calls Jeremiah Smith undoubtedly the best player in football.

stories.title: Who Ohio State needs to lose to make the College Football Playoff
stories.summary: After the third CFP rankings of the season, the updated rooting guide breaks down which contenders the Buckeyes need to stumble over the final weeks to keep playoff hopes alive.

stories.title: Alonso to miss Las Vegas FP1 as Aston Martin run Crawford at home
stories.summary: Aston Martin will put American reserve driver Jak Crawford in the AMR26 for first practice on the Vegas Strip - his first F1 session on home soil and fifth of the season - while Fernando Alonso sits the session out.

stories.title: Ecclestone urges Hamilton to consider retirement; Piastri penalty to be confirmed
stories.summary: Bernie Ecclestone says it is too late for Hamilton to change how Ferrari operates and the 41-year-old should think about quitting, while the FIA is expected to ratify the 10-place Las Vegas grid penalty for Oscar Piastri during Thursday practice.

stories.title: Formula 1 and WHOOP announce landmark partnership
stories.summary: The health-wearable company becomes an F1 Official Partner in a multi-year deal to weave driver biometrics into broadcast storytelling for fans. WHOOP will also back F1 ACADEMY efforts to develop female talent in motorsport.

stories.title: Piastri set for 10-place grid penalty at Las Vegas GP
stories.summary: A reliability issue forces a fifth internal combustion engine of the season on the McLaren driver, triggering a 10-place grid drop for the race. McLaren hopes the overtaking spots on the Strip - plus a new floor and the upgraded Mercedes turbo - can rescue the weekend.

stories.title: Ohio House weighs concealed carry at 18 - no permit, no training
stories.summary: SB 278 would lower the Ohio permitless-carry age from 21 to 18, allow loaded guns in vehicles, ease sawed-off shotgun and silencer rules, and let citizens sue cities over local gun laws for punitive damages. The lame-duck vote comes before Gov.-elect Amy Acton takes office in January.

stories.title: Sunny and dry through Saturday; rain likely late Sunday
stories.summary: Central Ohio stays sunny with highs climbing from 58 today to the mid-60s by Friday and Saturday, before a cold front brings rain late Sunday and knocks Thanksgiving week back into the 40s.
